answer.text:
This issue has been mentioned in a Slack conversation, not in documented policy. In the #random Slack channel, a team member reported: "I think there’s a bug in the time-off request form? It kept looping me back to the start page. Anyone else?" Another replied: "Yep, same here. I had to refresh twice. Maybe it’s the universe telling us to log off and start the weekend early 😅" (Slack, July 2026).

This indicates that at least two people have experienced the bug you described. However, this information comes from a conversation, not from official handbook documentation or policy. If you need to report the bug, follow the process for submitting issues via the Compass application as described in the handbook.

Owner for bug reporting: @isteward (Field Operations) [sales/field-operations/requesting-internal-support/_index#how-to-report-bugs-or-request-fixes]

How to Report Bugs or Request Fixes
nodes.text:
If you encounter any issues with creating a case for the internal support teams or with the form, please submit your request using [Compass application](/handbook/eta/corporate-it/compass/compass-guide/#how-to-get-help-3-ways-to-reach-compass), which can be accessed through the OKTA tile:

1. In Compass, select **IT**
2. Click on the **Break/Fix Request** type
3. The intake form will open and you'll need to populate the following fields:
   - **Which application** you need help with: Salesforce
   - **Short description**: add details of your issue
   - **Urgency**: select the urgency
   - Please **describe your issue**: add any relevant additional information
   - **Attachment**: submit a sc
